android.desc: 🌄 Wake up gently – with a real sunrise light alarm instead of a harsh sound Over 1 million people already start their mornings rested and calm — the way it should be. This alarm clock replaces the classic loud alarm with slowly increasing light and relax sounds — exactly what your body needs to wake up easily. ⭐ Help fall asleep – wake up gently In the evening, the app dims the light like a sunset and plays gradually fading sounds such as rain sounds for sleep or wave sounds. You can use calm music for sleep or calm meditation. In the morning, gentle light lifts you out of sleep — before any sound starts. ☀️ Your morning routine at a glance Right when you wake up, you see the local weather forecast with clothing suggestions, your personal birthday countdown — and if you like, you can start your day with a quick home workout. 🌅 Better sleep. Better wake-up. Every day. 👉 Download the free alarm clock now — and experience how good waking up can feel. Features: ✓ Alarm clock: Fully functional free alarm clock with repeat alarms and snooze function. ✓ True sunrise: The device changes colors from red to yellow like a real sunrise. ✓ Gentle sounds: Wake up with different natural sounds, instrumental music or your own favorite sounds. After a few minutes, it turns into a loud alarm for heavy sleepers. ✓ Big nightstand clock: A sleep clock that shows digital time and wake up time at night and can play sleep music to help you get to sleep faster. ✓ Radio Wakeup:Wake up to your favorite radio station. ✓ Power napping: Take a power nap during the day and wake up refreshed and with new energy after 20 min. ✓ Sleep timer: Easily fall asleep in the evening with a sunset and decreasingly gentle sounds (ASMR). ✓ Sleep aid: Helps to slow down your breathing to get you asleep faster and more relaxed. Set timer for the speed that you wish to decrease from. ✓ Sleeping sounds: Sleep better with background sounds! Choose from sounds like rain, wind, crickets or white noise.
